name: glyhub_GPST000239_GSL
title: Colorectal-cancer cell-line glycosphingolipid glycans
description: Relative glycosphingolipid-glycan abundances across 22 human colorectal-cancer cell lines spanning unassigned, undifferentiated and colon-like transcriptional subtypes.
details: Supplementary Table S5 supplies 94 chromatographically distinguished glycan features and cell-line aggregate abundance values. Cell-line origin, tumour stage, differentiation and microsatellite status are joined from Table S1 when the source identifier matches exactly. Original antigen, glycan-family and linkage annotations are retained. Typed structures are transcribed from the same-row SNFG diagrams with all unspecified linkages left unknown; repeated compositions remain separate isomer features. Values are cell-line summaries, not individual biological-replicate measurements.
